name: Alther's Mill
summary: In the Redridge Mountains, Alther's Mill lies in ruins northeast of Lakeshire. Once it supplied timber to local builders, but now scavengers and predators haunt its grounds. Travelers heading east toward Stonewatch pass this grim mark of the frontier.

sections.title: An Abandoned Frontier Mill
sections.body: Alther's Mill once supplied timber for Lakeshire and the nearby settlements. The clearing northeast of Lake Everstill gave millers access to timber in the mountains. Trouble spread across Stormwind's kingdom, and the Blackrock clan came down from the heights of Stonewatch. The millers abandoned their work, leaving the timber buildings and wheel to decay.

sections.title: Shadows and Scrap
sections.body: With the workers gone, monstrous tarantulas, carrion vultures, and raiders took over the mill. Travelers on the path to the eastern passes must skirt its shadowed grounds carefully. Shadowy operatives and thieves also use the abandoned compound. Its discarded storage boxes and hidden corners let them practice lockpicking and carry out covert trades beyond the Lakeshire Town Watch's gaze.

faq.answer: Alther's Mill lies northeast of Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. It once harvested and processed timber for nearby settlements, until dangers in the wilderness forced the millers to leave.

The mill was abandoned as regional defenses weakened after the First and Second Wars. Giant spiders and Blackrock orcs made the frontier too dangerous for ordinary laborers without royal military protection.

faq.q: What creatures roam around the mill?
faq.answer: Giant mountain tarantulas, scavenger buzzards, and roving predators overrun the mill grounds and nearby scrublands. Stray marauders also travel between Stonewatch and Lake Everstill.

faq.q: Why do rogues visit Alther's Mill?
faq.answer: Alliance rogues visit Alther's Mill to practice picking locked footlockers. Their trainers send them to the isolated, debris-strewn grounds to earn valuable thieving certifications.

angles.text: As a rogue of the Alliance, you know Alther's Mill as a quiet place to practice lockpicking. Thieves' syndicates use its scattered lockboxes and secluded grounds for training.
For the Alliance, Alther's Mill recalls Stormwind's strained frontier garrisons. Valuable industry lies broken and abandoned within sight of Lakeshire.
